subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent config default for TUI delivery, and if so should the canonical key be `tui.deliver` or `cli.tui.deliver`?
rationale: The current source and docs intentionally treat TUI delivery as launch-time, off-by-default behavior, and AGENTS.md/VISION.md set a high bar for new config/default surfaces even when the ergonomics request is valid.

options.title: Approve a narrow TUI config key
options.body: Add one documented schema key for the launch default, preserve explicit flag override behavior, and include focused regression tests for unset, config-on, and explicit flag cases.

options.title: Keep flag-only behavior
options.body: Leave current off-by-default delivery as the contract and close or reframe the request as a docs/workaround issue rather than adding config surface.

options.title: Defer into broader delivery policy
options.body: Keep this issue open behind a wider delivery/defaults design if maintainers want TUI, WebChat, and channel delivery defaults decided together.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow TUI config key
recommendation.body: Add one documented schema key for the launch default, preserve explicit flag override behavior, and include focused regression tests for unset, config-on, and explicit flag cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is product/config policy, and current-main blame plus repository ownership signals point most strongly to steipete for that decision.
